d.ko: Step into the world of endurance racing and race on the official game of the FIA World Endurance Championship and 24 Hours of Le Mans. Race the latest Hypercars, LMGT3, LMP2 and GTE machinery on laser-scanned circuits with dynamic weather, ranked online competition, asynchronous Co-op and VR.

rv.t: 오늘부로 현대차 지지를 철회한다 오늘부터 지지관계에서 벗어나 제네시스와(과) 나는 한몸으로 일체가 된다 제네시스에 대한 공격은 나에 대한 공격으로 간주한다 세상에 70억 명의 제네시스 팬이 있다면, 나는 그들 중 한 명일 것이다. …

네,다른거 다좋은데 제바랄ㄹㄹㄹㄹ 쟤가 잘못했는데 왜 내 점수가 쌍방으로 깎이는지 의문이네요~
If your bad at racing in this game, practice, practice, practice. Because tough times never last, only tough people last.

The fact you get penalized for other people hitting you is ABSURD. What a joke, otherwise, great game. Edit: I love everything about this game except the contact system and support. Legit a joke, especially if you pay for a service.

Cannot just set up a co-op endurance race with friends because you need credits, it has to be the daily events, which are not numerous, and some of which are DLC. I don't understand why I can't buy a game and then have the game.
游戏是好游戏，建议将所有安全分低的玩家都放到pve，到达一定安全阀才给pvp，或者加大违法者的处罚力度
好游戏，但是玩家太不文明了，应该先通过考试再允许进行多人游戏，随便乱鱼雷的现象必须要整治，凭什么我在前面被后车牵连我也要减安全分？后车自己看不见我留的空间非往我身上撞还是我的问题了？
为什么最开始季票卖128，现在买要390，新玩家难道就活该被当成猪宰吗。
